prompts.approx: Keep your thinking to approximately {budget} tokens.
prompts.cap: Use at most {budget} tokens for your thinking.
prompts.scoped: Use at most {budget} tokens for your thinking. This limit applies only to the thinking section, excluding the final answer.
prompts.ceiling: Use at most {budget} tokens for your thinking. This limit applies only to the thinking section, excluding the final answer. It is an upper limit, not a required length; shorter thinking is allowed. Do not add text merely to reach the token limit.
prompts.explicit_end: Use at most {budget} tokens for your thinking. This limit applies only to the thinking section, excluding the final answer. It is an upper limit, not a required length; shorter thinking is allowed. Do not add text merely to reach the token limit. End the thinking section with </think> no later than this limit, then provide the final answer in the originally requested format.
